result.instructions: Tools for Checkout.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Checkout.com data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run checkoutcom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run checkoutcom_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run checkoutcom_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. checkoutcom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: checkout_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Get the full details of a payment (or payment session) by its id, e.g. 'pay_...'. Checkout.com: GET /payments/{id}.

id.description: Payment id, e.g. 'pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4' (or a 'sid_' payment session id).

tools.name: checkout_list_payments
tools.title: List payments by reference
tools.description: List your business's payments that match a given reference. Checkout.com: GET /payments (query parameters). For richer filtering use checkout_search_payments.

reference.description: Return only payments with this reference.

limit.description: Maximum number of payments to return.

skip.description: Number of payments to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: checkout_search_payments
tools.title: Search payments
tools.description: Search payments using flexible query filters (this is a READ — it queries, it does not mutate). Checkout.com: POST /payments/search. Pass a `query` filter object and/or paging fields.

query.description: Search filter object, e.g. { reference, id, status, currency, amount, from, to }.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

pagination.description: Cursor pagination object (e.g. { after, before }) as returned in previous responses.

tools.name: checkout_get_payment_actions
tools.title: Get payment actions
tools.description: List all the actions (authorization, capture, refund, void, etc.) associated with a payment, latest first. Checkout.com: GET /payments/{id}/actions.

tools.name: checkout_get_payment_link
tools.title: Get payment link
tools.description: Retrieve the details and status of a Payment Link by its id, e.g. 'pl_...'. Checkout.com: GET /payment-links/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a customer's details (email, name, phone, saved instruments) by id 'cus_...' or by email. Checkout.com: GET /customers/{id}.

id.description: Customer id ('cus_...') or the customer's email address.

tools.name: checkout_get_instrument
tools.title: Get instrument
tools.description: Get the details of a saved payment instrument (tokenized card / bank account) by id 'src_...'. Checkout.com: GET /instruments/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_list_disputes
tools.title: List disputes
tools.description: List disputes (chargebacks) against your business, most-recently-modified first, with optional filters. Checkout.com: GET /disputes.

limit.description: Maximum number of disputes to return (default 20).

skip.description: Number of disputes to skip (pagination offset).

statuses.description: Comma-separated dispute statuses to filter by, e.g. 'evidence_required,arbitration'.

payment_id.description: Filter to disputes for a specific payment id ('pay_...').

entity_ids.description: Comma-separated sub-entity ids to filter by (for platforms).

this_channel_only.description: If true, only return disputes for the authenticating channel.

from.description: Only disputes last modified on/after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

to.description: Only disputes last modified on/before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

tools.name: checkout_get_dispute
tools.title: Get dispute
tools.description: Get all the details of a single dispute (reason code, amount, deadline, evidence status) by id 'dsp_...'. Checkout.com: GET /disputes/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the reports available on your account (settlement, payments, etc.) and their details. Checkout.com: GET /reports.

created_after.description: Only reports created on/after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only reports created on/before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

entity_id.description: Filter reports to a specific entity id (for platforms).

limit.description: Maximum number of reports to return.

tools.name: checkout_get_report
tools.title: Get report
tools.description: Get the metadata of a specific report (including its downloadable files) by id 'rpt_...'. Checkout.com: GET /reports/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_get_forex_rates
tools.title: Get forex rates
tools.description: Get the indicative foreign-exchange rates Checkout.com uses (e.g. for card payouts). Checkout.com: GET /forex/rates.

currency_pairs.description: Comma-separated currency pairs, e.g. 'GBPEUR,USDNOK' (required, up to 20 pairs).

product.description: Product the rates are for, e.g. 'card_payouts'.

processing_channel_id.description: Processing channel id ('pc_...') to scope the rates.

tools.name: checkout_create_payment
tools.title: Create payment
tools.description: CREATES a payment (request an authorization, or an immediate capture) — this MOVES MONEY: it charges a card / payment source. Checkout.com: POST /payments. Provide `amount` (minor units), `currency`, and a `source` object such as { type: 'token', token: 'tok_...' }, { type: 'id', id: 'src_...' } (a saved instrument), or { type: 'customer', id: 'cus_...' }.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's MINOR units (e.g. 1000 = $10.00; 0 = card verification). Required.

source.description: Payment source object. Required. E.g. { type:'token', token:'tok_...' }, { type:'id', id:'src_...' }, or { type:'customer', id:'cus_...' }.

reference.description: Your reference for the payment (e.g. order id).

capture.description: If true (default for card), capture immediately; if false, authorize only.

description.description: Description shown on the customer's statement / for your records.

customer.description: Customer object to associate/create, e.g. { id:'cus_...' } or { email, name }.

processing_channel_id.description: Processing channel id ('pc_...') to route the payment through.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the payment.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header to safely retry.

tools.name: checkout_capture_payment
tools.title: Capture payment
tools.description: CAPTURES a previously authorized payment — this MOVES MONEY: it settles the (full or partial) authorized amount. Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/captures.

id.description: Payment id to capture, e.g. 'pay_...'. Required.

amount.description: Amount to capture in MINOR units (defaults to the full authorized amount).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the capture.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.

tools.name: checkout_refund_payment
tools.title: Refund payment
tools.description: REFUNDS a captured payment — this MOVES MONEY BACK to the customer (full or partial). Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/refunds.

id.description: Payment id to refund, e.g. 'pay_...'. Required.

amount.description: Amount to refund in MINOR units (defaults to the full captured amount).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the refund.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.

tools.name: checkout_void_payment
tools.title: Void payment
tools.description: VOIDS (cancels) a payment that has been authorized but not yet captured — this releases the hold on the customer's funds. Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/voids.

id.description: Payment id to void, e.g. 'pay_...'. Required.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the void.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.

tools.name: checkout_create_payment_link
tools.title: Create payment link
tools.description: CREATES a hosted Payment Link the customer can pay through — this sets up a way to COLLECT MONEY. Checkout.com: POST /payment-links. Returns a URL to share with the customer.

reference.description: Your reference for the payment link (e.g. order id).

description.description: Description shown to the customer on the payment page.

products.description: Line items, each e.g. { name, quantity, unit_price }.

return_url.description: URL the customer is returned to after paying.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the payment link.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.

tools.name: checkout_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: CREATES a customer record (which saved instruments and future payments can be attached to). This ADDS data to your account. Checkout.com: POST /customers.

email.description: Customer email address (required, must be unique on the account).

default.description: Id of the default instrument ('src_...') for this customer.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the customer.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header.
